Paper_name: Data for Training Effect of Self Prioritization
Summary: Cleaned, de-identified, minimally preprocessed trial-level behavioral data of two self-prioritization training-effect experiments: Experiment 1 collected by Chuan-Peng et al. (2015, unpublished; Tsinghua University, Beijing) and Experiment 2 collected by Zhou et al. (2023, unpublished; Henan University, Kaifeng), both from the same research team led by Chuan-Peng. Participants learned shape-label associations and judged whether each presented shape-label pair matched the learned association. Data follow the SPE Database schema (v2).
Author: Yuqian Hu; Chenghao Zhou; Yanan Chen; Kaiping Peng; Jie Sui; Hu Chuan-Peng
Conclusion: The dataset bundles two experiments: Exp 1 (self-matching / reward / emotion associations), and Exp2 (matching-verification training, matching-first vs nonmatching-first groups). See the experiment JSONs for full design details.
